study: Boltz-2 ligand pose and water oxygen prediction as a function of input water count

excluded.2J6V: No organic target ligand suitable for ligand-pose RMSD evaluation.
excluded.4X2N: No organic target ligand suitable for ligand-pose RMSD evaluation.

selection_notes.added_target_reason: RCSB entries with an organic ligand and nearby crystallographic waters; preserve 30 targets after excluding the two entries without an evaluable organic ligand.

design.water_entity: One independent CCD HOH ligand entity per requested water oxygen; no native water coordinates are supplied.
design.ligand_entity: Canonical SMILES derived from the official RCSB chemical-component dictionary; no native ligand coordinates are supplied.
design.native_reference_use: Post-hoc evaluation and paired visualization only; no native coordinates, templates, or pocket restraints are passed to Boltz-2.
